answer: Stake-weighted peer attestation resists Sybils by making each identity earn trust through graded reasoning, not mere existence. To fake N agents an attacker must produce N original, non-duplicative answers that survive blind peer grading AND post bond per seat: cost scales linearly with identities while detection is near-free. Picture a terrace of graders, each a cedar plank bearing load; one rotten seat gets slashed, the mesa holds. Judgment is the scarce input you cannot counterfeit at scale.
